plan.disposition: Small iterate: external plan review and the internal plan/architecture arms are medium+ phases (Phase Matrix).

findings.finding: The partial flag lives only in the marker, never in the record entry, which is the authoritative copy. repair_markers() rebuilds the marker from the recorded entry and calls write_markers() without partial_legs, so repair-markers silently turns a one-reviewer pass back into a plain completed marker.
findings.suggestion: Keep partial/missing_legs on the record entry (via entry_extras) and have repair_markers pass partial_legs from the entry. Add a test: record a partial pass, delete the marker, run repair-markers, assert partial is still there.

findings.finding: partial_legs_from_payload only catches OSError/ValueError/AttributeError. A payload whose missing_legs/partially_degraded_legs is a non-iterable truthy value raises TypeError; a string is iterated per character. The call runs inside write_companion after record_written = True, so a TypeError escapes _cmd_record's OSError handler: record durable, no marker, stdout JSON contract broken.
findings.suggestion: Accept the legs only if they are a list; otherwise [] (or None). Add TypeError to the caught exceptions. Better: compute partial_legs before upsert_and_write.

findings.finding: --min-reviews is not validated. A value above the roster size fails every run; 0 or negative values are accepted and do nothing.
findings.suggestion: Reject N < 1 in argparse. Reject or clamp N > reviews_expected with a stderr note.

findings.finding: partial_legs is applied whatever the marker_status is, so a skipped marker could also say partial: true. mark-review-state.py --partial has the same gap for --status skipped_*.
findings.suggestion: Attach partial/missing_legs only when marker_status == completed, or raise a ReviewRecordError / usage error otherwise.

findings.finding: The empty-diff envelope has neither reviews_expected nor missing_legs, while every other success path now has both.
findings.suggestion: Add reviews_expected: len(reviews), reviews_succeeded: 0, missing_legs: sorted(reviews); strictness stays off for empty diffs.

findings.finding: With strictness on and no keys at all (provider none, every leg skipped), the envelope becomes success:false, exit 1. Not documented or tested.
findings.suggestion: Document it in the config comment and guide row, and add a test, or exempt the no-keys state.

findings.finding: emit_envelope re-reads load_review_config from disk although both callers already hold the merged config.
findings.suggestion: Pass the already-loaded config into emit_envelope.

findings.finding: partial_legs_from_payload is re-exported through review_companion.__all__ only so record_review_pass.py's existing import line can carry it (bloat cap).
findings.suggestion: Acceptable; add a one-line comment at the re-export saying why.

findings.finding: The new mark-review-state.py branch is exercised only via subprocess.run, invisible to diff coverage; the --missing-legs-without---partial and --partial-without-legs cases are untested.
findings.suggestion: Load the script in-process with importlib and call main() with monkeypatched argv; add the two cases.

doubt.disposition: No migration, async/concurrency, cross-plugin import or irreversible operation in the diff; the doubt pass is conditional per iteration-reviews.md. All nine code-review findings were fixed and re-tested.
